text:
Hannah Lee: Hey team! 👋 I'm Hannah (she/her), starting today as an ML Infrastructure Engineer, remote from Seattle for the first two weeks. I lift kettlebells, brew terrible espresso, and will definitely ask too many questions about GPUs. Excited to be here!
Marcus Gomez: Welcome Hannah!! :tada: Glad to have you. We do a casual remote lunch for new hires on Fridays — I'll send a Zoom link. Also there's a quick "intro + swag" scavenger hunt in the SF office if you ever swing by.
Ivy Park: Hi Hannah, I'm your onboarding buddy this month. Ping me for badge requests, VPN access, and repo perms. I can also walk you through the dev VM if you'd like a pair session.
onboarding-bot: Welcome @Hannah Lee! You've been added to #new-hires and granted access to the "ML Infra Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/ml-infra (automated)
Hannah Lee: Thanks so much! Small note: allergic to tree nuts, so happy to bring nut-free snacks for team lunch. Also — is there a Slack ritual for new folks?
Marcus Gomez: Noted on allergies  we usually have a couple of nut-free options. Slack ritual: quick "two truth/one lie" in the courtyard if you're in SF, otherwise we do a virtual icebreaker. Meme channel Friday afternoons is mandatory entertainment. :laughing:
Ivy Park: Sent a 30-min intro calendar invite for Wed 9am PT to go through PR process and infra access. Also added you to the oncall-shadow list (read-only) so you can peek at paging flow without getting paged.
Facilities: Hi Hannah! Welcome kit shipped to your address on file (hoodie M, sticker pack, desk plant). If you need anything else sent, DM facilities.
Hannah Lee: Hoodie M sounds perfect, thanks! Looking forward to the lunch and the kettlebell-to-GPU metaphors. See you all soon :)
